name: Te Henua Enata – The Marquesas Islands
description: The Marquesas are a remote chain of volcanic islands in French Polynesia, in the South Pacific. Jagged ridges, spire-like peaks and sheer cliffs rise straight from the ocean. Voyagers settled here around 1000 CE and left stone platforms, carvings and engravings among the forests. Seabirds, rare endemic plants and almost untouched waters make the archipelago equally remarkable.
